label: Data Structures & Algorithms
blurb: Learn DSA the fast way: 12 patterns, drawn and traced step by step, with Python code, complexity and 300+ solved problems.
title: Data Structures and Algorithms: The Fast Pattern Way
subtitle: A beginner-to-interview-ready guide in Python. Learn the 12 patterns behind almost every problem, see each one drawn and traced step by step, then solve problems from easy to hard.
tagline: Taught the IIT Professor Way — Real Numbers. Real Problems. Real Understanding.
appendix_sub: Every pattern, template and complexity from Chapters 1 to 12 on one page. Use it for revision, not for first learning.

chapters.title: How to Learn DSA Fast, Big-O and Your Python Toolkit
chapters.sub: A 12-week method, how to measure speed, and the Python built-ins you will use in every solution.

chapters.title: Arrays, Strings and Hashing
chapters.sub: Lookups in constant time: dictionaries, sets, counting, grouping and the two-sum family.

chapters.title: Two Pointers, Sliding Window and Prefix Sums
chapters.sub: Three tricks that turn slow nested loops into one clean pass.

chapters.title: Sorting and Binary Search
chapters.sub: How sorting works, when to sort first, and binary search on indexes and on answers.

chapters.title: Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues and Monotonic Structures
chapters.sub: Pointer problems, parentheses, next-greater element, and deque tricks, all drawn.

chapters.title: Recursion and Backtracking
chapters.sub: Think in the recursion tree: subsets, permutations, combinations, N-Queens and pruning.

chapters.title: Trees, Binary Search Trees, Heaps and Tries
chapters.sub: Traversals, depth and height, BST rules, priority queues, top-K and prefix trees.

chapters.title: Graphs: BFS, DFS, Topological Sort, Union-Find and Shortest Paths
chapters.sub: Model a problem as a graph, then pick the right traversal or algorithm.

chapters.title: Dynamic Programming from Zero
chapters.sub: Overlapping subproblems made simple: 1D, 2D, knapsack, strings and the five-step recipe.

chapters.title: Greedy, Intervals, Bits and Math Tricks
chapters.sub: When the locally best choice is globally best, merging intervals, bit tricks and number theory.

chapters.title: Designing Data Structures: LRU Cache, Autocomplete and More
chapters.sub: Combine structures to build the systems that interviews and real products need.

chapters.title: Pattern Recognition, Mock Interviews and a 12-Week Plan
chapters.sub: How to recognise the pattern in 2 minutes, a problem map, mock-interview routine and revision plan.
